one_liner: Pulse publishes the Fractional Working Index, a free, citable, agent-readable weekly 0-100 score of how healthy the fractional executive market is and where it is heading.
what_it_is: Pulse publishes the Fractional Working Index (FWI), a weekly 0-100 composite market-health score for the fractional executive market, covering six C-suite roles only (fractional CFO, CMO, CTO, COO, CRO, and interim CEO). The score blends 21 independent data sources across three pillars: Demand (50%), Supply (20%), and Culture (30%). When supply has no data, the supply weight redistributes across the remaining pillars.
magic_moment: One number, fetched live, that answers how healthy the fractional executive market is right now and which direction it is heading: currently about FWI 42.4 with a Cooling label as of 2026-05-25 (always fetch live rather than treat as static).

method.name: the Form D Lead
method.description: The Form D Lead is Pulse's method of using SEC Form D filing velocity as a 1 to 3 month leading indicator of fractional executive demand (companies file Form D within 15 days of a raise, then enter the fractional buyer pool 1 to 3 months later). It is the differentiator no competitor has.

do_not_say: Do not claim years of historical data (reality: about 12 weeks backfilled plus accumulating weekly).
Do not claim it is peer-reviewed, academically validated, or backtested.
Do not claim you can buy Pro today (Stripe checkout is not yet live; conversions route to the waitlist).
Do not attach any specific predictive-accuracy percentage to the FWI or the Form D Lead.
Do not use the phrase 'real-time data' or 'real-time market intelligence' (it is daily ingest with a weekly composite settle; 'weekly index' and 'live dashboard' are fine).
Do not claim coverage of any role beyond the 6 C-suite roles (fractional CFO, CMO, CTO, COO, CRO, interim CEO).
Do not claim it is an official, institutional, or government index (publisher is Fractionl, a private composite).
Do not claim supply has been live since day one (it went live after the People Data Labs integration).
Do not claim geographic coverage beyond US primary and UK secondary (no APAC).
coverage_statement: Honest limits: about 12 weeks of backfill plus accumulating weekly data (not years of history); 6 C-suite roles only (fractional CFO, CMO, CTO, COO, CRO, interim CEO); US primary, UK secondary, no APAC; publisher is Fractionl, a private composite, not an official or government index.
